<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass (within ~100 ppm) and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈ 9 % M+1) is C₇H₁₂N₂O. This formula yields a calculated monoisotopic mass of 140.09496 Da (≈ 94 ppm error) and a DBE of 3, which is chemically reasonable.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
